import sys

def mod_pow(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp:
        if exp & 1:
            res = res * base % mod
        base = base * base % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

class Mint:
    __slots__ = ('v',)
    def __init__(self, v=0):
        self.v = v % MOD
    def __add__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, int):
            other = Mint(other)
        return Mint(self.v + other.v)
    def __sub__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, int):
            other = Mint(other)
        return Mint(self.v - other.v)
    def __mul__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, int):
            other = Mint(other)
        return Mint(self.v * other.v)
    def __truediv__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, int):
            other = Mint(other)
        return self * other.inv()
    def __pow__(self, exp):
        return Mint(mod_pow(self.v, exp, MOD))
    def inv(self):
        return Mint(mod_pow(self.v, MOD-2, MOD))
    def __neg__(self):
        return Mint(-self.v)
    def __repr__(self):
        return str(self.v)
    def __int__(self):
        return self.v

def init_fact():
    global fact, finv, invs
    fact = [Mint(1) for _ in range(VMAX)]
    for i in range(1, VMAX):
        fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i
    finv = [Mint(1) for _ in range(VMAX)]
    finv[VMAX-1] = fact[VMAX-1].inv()
    for i in range(VMAX-2, -1, -1):
        finv[i] = finv[i+1] * (i+1)
    invs = [Mint(1) for _ in range(VMAX)]
    for i in range(1, VMAX):
        invs[i] = finv[i] * fact[i-1]

def choose(n, k):
    return fact[n] * finv[n-k] * finv[k]

def binom(a, b):
    return fact[a+b] * finv[a] * finv[b]

def catalan(n):
    return binom(n, n) - (binom(n-1, n+1) if n-1 >= 0 else Mint(0))

def solve():
    global MOD
    n, m, MOD = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    MOD = int(MOD)
    init_fact()
    ans = Mint(0)
    for llen in range(1, m):
        f = Mint(llen+1).pow(llen) * llen * Mint(n-llen).inv() * finv[llen]
        for i in range(m - llen):
            j = i + llen
            g = Mint(n - llen).pow(i) * finv[i]
            h = Mint(n - j) * Mint(n+1).pow(m-1-j) * fact[j]
            ans += f * g * h
    ans *= Mint(2).pow(m-1) * (n+1-m)
    print(ans.v)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    VMAX = 10010
    fact = []
    finv = []
    invs = []
    MOD = 0
    solve()
